archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for Technical/SOC Dashboard)
concept: Tactical Control Room / Data-Dense NOC Console

layout.strategy: Mode B: The Control Room Grid
layout.container: w-full min-h-screen bg-[#050505] text-white overflow-x-hidden flex

sections.sidebar: w-16 hidden md:flex flex-col border-r border-[#222] bg-[#050505] items-center py-6 gap-8
sections.header: h-20 border-b border-[#222] flex items-center justify-between px-6
sections.dashboard_grid: flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-6 auto-rows-min

button.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-none font-mono text-sm uppercase px-4 py-2 transition-colors
button.danger: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#D62828] rounded-none font-mono text-sm uppercase px-4 py-2 transition-colors
button.outline: border border-[#444] text-white hover:bg-[#222] hover:border-white rounded-none font-mono text-sm uppercase px-4 py-2 transition-all
button.ghost: text-secondary hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] rounded-none px-4 py-2 transition-colors

badge.safe: bg-[#0044FF]/10 text-[#0044FF] border border-[#0044FF]/30 rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase
badge.warning: bg-[#FFCC00]/10 text-[#FFCC00] border border-[#FFCC00]/30 rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase
badge.danger: bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] border border-[#FF3B30]/30 animate-pulse rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase
badge.quarantined: bg-[#555555]/10 text-[#888] border border-[#555]/30 rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase

components.input: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#333] rounded-none text-white font-mono text-sm px-3 py-2 focus:border-white focus:outline-none transition-colors
components.table_header: text-[10px] uppercase text-secondary border-b border-[#222] bg-[#0A0A0A]

micro_interactions.hover: Sharp color transitions, 1px border highlights, no shadow lifting.
micro_interactions.scan_progress: Matrix-like character shuffling or a rigid linear progress bar with a blinking terminal cursor.
micro_interactions.threat_alert: Red 1px border flash on the container, accompanied by a typing effect for the alert log.

icons.usage: Use precise technical icons: Activity, ShieldAlert, Cpu, HardDrive, Wifi, RadioTower, Crosshair, TerminalSquare, AlertTriangle, Fingerprint.

background_texture.description: Dark abstract texture for subtle noise overlay on the dashboard background.
background_texture.usage: Apply to the main container with opacity-5 and mix-blend-overlay to kill the digital flatness.

instructions_to_main_agent: SETUP SHADCN: Initialize Shadcn and add components: sheet, button, input, badge, progress, dialog, scroll-area, tabs, table.
STYLING: Strictly enforce flat, sharp geometry (rounded-none). Remove all box-shadows. Use 1px solid borders for separation.
LAYOUT - APP SHELL: Create a left sidebar for nav (icons) and a main content area. The main area should have a top header with a scrolling Threat Feed Marquee.
DASHBOARD GRID: The main view has two columns. Left (Fleet Grid) and Right (Scanner & AI Ticker).

FLEET GRID: Display a data-dense list/table of monitored devices (Tesla Model S, Linux Server, MacBook, Camera 04). Include columns: Device ID, OS/Type, IP Address, Memory Load, Status (Badge). Click a row to open the Device Detail Sheet.

DEVICE DETAIL (SHEET): When a device is selected, open a Shadcn Sheet from the right. It must contain: Memory Map (visual blocks or hex dump UI), Running Processes list, Network Connections, and RAT/Rootkit surface checks. Include a large 'ISOLATE/QUARANTINE' button.

SCANNER WIDGET: A dedicated card for 'URL/File Heuristic Analysis'. Provide an input field and upload zone. On submit, show a terminal-like progress, then an AI Verdict (Risk Score 0-100, IOCs found, AI reasoning text).
THREAT LOG: A terminal-style scrolling list of recent alerts. Use JetBrains Mono. Prefix with timestamps.

DATA-TESTID: Ensure EVERY interactive element (buttons, inputs, rows, tabs, dialogs) has a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='scan-submit-button'`, `data-testid='device-row-1'`).
NOISE OVERLAY: Use the provided background_texture image as a fixed, low-opacity (5%) overlay to give a 'tactical military screen' feel.
